labels.label: [2.1]/[2.3] flat spacetimes are manifolds: second countability (DEC-49), prose, no ledger label

hypotheses.note: T2Space M; needed (line with uncountably many origins)
any (G,E)-structure, E a separable real normed space, G acting analytically by homeomorphisms; affine faithful actions as a corollary

kb_proposals: Second countability of a (G,X)-manifold over a separable normed E: apply Causal.secondCountableTopology_of_isLocalHomeomorph to the developing map on UniversalCover M x0, then IsQuotientMap.secondCountableTopology along proj; no path-lifting or broken-line argument is needed (ball sections at a countable dense set of centres have clopen closure).
IsSeparatedMap.eqOn_of_comp_eqOn (Mathlib/Topology/SeparatedMap.lean) is the uniqueness of local sections of a local homeomorphism with Hausdorff source over a preconnected set.
